crops.note: Commercial Aircraft segment icon: a photographic Airbus A380 in house livery, above the 'Airbus' segment label. The airplane nose extends right to ~x399; the cropBox right edge is x408, staying clear of the '(11%) Y/Y' note that begins at ~x409 and the navy segment node bar at x435. Kept as an opaque, background-matched rectangular patch (background removal disabled) because the photo sits on the uniform #f2f2f2 chart background, so the patch blends seamlessly when re-placed at its source coordinates. borderBand is 0 because this is an intentional background-matched patch, not a transparent die-cut icon; subject detection (threshold 18) still centers the crop on the airplane and centerOffset is validated. Excludes the '€8.4B'/'(11%) Y/Y' value block, the 'Airbus' segment name, and the AIRBUS wordmark.

Opaque background-matched patch (background removal disabled) on the uniform #f2f2f2 chart background. borderBand 0 (intentional patch). Excludes the value block and the segment name.

AIRBUS company wordmark set in the brand's custom navy logotype, above the Revenue hub. Isolated on the uniform #f2f2f2 chart background with clear margins to the title above (baseline ~y198) and the flows below (~y500). Kept as an opaque background-matched raster patch rather than approximated as bold Arial text, which under-rendered the wordmark width (textLength 286 vs the source 540px).
